name: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
description: Ten-year-old Hazel Wells has just moved to the big city of Dimmadelphia because of her dad’s new job. On top of being in an unfamiliar environment, it’s the first time she’s been without her brother, Antony, who’s just left for college, leaving her lonely and unsure of herself. All that changes when the pink-and-green-haired neighbors next door reveal that they are no ordinary neighbors…they’re Cosmo and Wanda, fairy godparents! And they’re coming out of retirement to make all of Hazel’s wishes come true.

videos.title: Fly
videos.overview: 10-year-old Hazel tries to run away from home, leading her to discover that her weird neighbors, Cosmo and Wanda, are really Fairy Godparents in disguise.

videos.title: The Department of Magical Violations
videos.overview: Hazel, Cosmo and Wanda must pass Wish Trials at the Fairy DMV or Jorgen Von Strangle will assign Hazel a new fairy.

videos.title: Teacher's Pal
videos.overview: Nervous about not fitting in with the other kids at school, Hazel wishes that she were friends with her teachers instead.

videos.title: A Dinosaur in Dimmadelphia
videos.overview: When Hazel wishes she could meet a real dinosaur, Cosmo and Wanda bring a Baryonyx from the Cretaceous period to present day!

videos.title: Fearless
videos.overview: Hazel wishes Jasmine was fearless but the wish goes awry when Jasmine's fears escape and run amuck around the school!

videos.title: The Wellsington Hotellsington
videos.overview: Hazel wishes her apartment building were a luxury hotel but finds herself too busy running it to spend time with her friends.

videos.title: 1500 Minutes of Fame
videos.overview: Hazel wishes she were the center of attention at school, but quickly becomes overwhelmed and calls on fairies to speed up time.

videos.title: 28 Puddings Later
videos.overview: When Hazel tries to make Pudding Day at school fair for everyone, she accidentally starts a pudding apocalypse.

videos.title: Trial & Hair-ror
videos.overview: When Hazel wishes her hair had "spirit" for a school contest, she finds it has more personality than she bargained for!

videos.title: Weird Science
videos.overview: Cosmo and Wanda rewrite the laws of science in order to make Hazel's science fair project work.

videos.title: Mystery She Wished
videos.overview: When Hazel's landlord goes missing, she solicits Cosmo and Wanda's help to get to the bottom of the case.

videos.title: Prime Meridian Love
videos.overview: Hazel rewrites the book, when she wishes the main character from her favorite Manga graphic novel, into the real world.

videos.title: Stanky Danky
videos.overview: Hazel befriends a walking, talking dumpster named Danky after learning about humans' harmful effects on the environment.

videos.title: Peace of Pizza
videos.overview: Dev refuses to participate in Kindness Day at school, so Hazel summons a few intergalactic diplomats to keep the peace.

videos.title: A New Dev-elopment
videos.overview: Hazel must work with her nemesis, Dev, on a class project and discovers a softer side to the meanest kid in school.

videos.title: Cookie's Court
videos.overview: After losing Hazel to Cosmo and Wanda during the Wish Trials, Cookie returns for revenge.

videos.title: Lost and Founder's Day
videos.overview: Dev's dad, tech magnate, Dale Dimmadome creates an app designed to track kids wish energy at the annual Founder's Day Festival, but Hazel is showing up as an anomaly thanks to Cosmo and Wanda.

videos.title: Work Her Magic
videos.overview: Fed up with Angela's work life imbalance, Hazel wishes she could be her mom's assistant in order to spend more time with her.

videos.title: Crock to the Future
videos.overview: When Hazel's Cosmo and Wanda fidget toys are confiscated at the Galax Institute, she pairs with a janitor to get them back.

videos.title: Battle of the Dimmsonian
videos.overview: With Dev's new fairy granting wishes, Hazel and Dev battle it out dueling wish-style during a spooky night at the museum.

videos.title: Patty Possum's Party Playground
videos.overview: When Winn grows sad that Patty Possum's Party Playground is not the same as it used to be, Hazel wishes Patty Possum was alive.

videos.title: A Date to Remember
videos.overview: Hazel must out-matchmake Cupid himself or her parents' memories will be erased forever.

videos.title: Lost in Fairy World
videos.overview: Dev and Hazel wind up lost in Fairy World; Cosmo, Wanda, and Peri try to find them.

videos.title: The Treble with Rivals
videos.overview: Hazel accidentally erases music from the earth when she awakens a rivalry.

videos.title: Rattleconda Racers
videos.overview: Hazel and Antony enter a world of dirt bike racing and giant snakes when her wish sends them into a board game.

videos.title: Dig a Little Deeper
videos.overview: Hazel finds herself in hot magma with a civilization of subterranean rock monsters.

videos.title: Potazel Potahzel
videos.overview: Hazel wishes for all her meals to only be potato related and things literally get to her head!

videos.title: Operation: Birthday Takeback
videos.overview: Cosmo, Wanda, and Peri discover Dev's dad has been investigating Hazel.

videos.title: The Haunting of Wells House
videos.overview: After several paranormal incidents in the Wells Home, Marcus investigates.

videos.title: Best of Luck
videos.overview: Dev teams up with an infamous anti-fairy to give Hazel an epic run of bad luck.

videos.title: Hazel Wells and the Multiverse of Jenkins
videos.overview: Hazel wishes for a do-over but finds herself trapped in a magical time-loop.

videos.title: Growing Pains
videos.overview: When Hazel wishes to be 13 to get into a movie, the fairy version of puberty hits her all at once.

videos.title: Fairy for a Day
videos.overview: Hazel wishes to be a fairy for a day, but things go awry when her anti-fairy shows up.

videos.title: Stuck in My Head
videos.overview: When Hazel, Winn, and Jasmine fail a BFF compatibility test, Hazel makes a wish that lands them inside her mind.

videos.title: Mind the Gap
videos.overview: When Hazel wishes she didn't have a gap in her teeth, the Tooth Fairy fills her gap.

videos.title: The Battle of Big Wand
videos.overview: Hazel makes her one millionth wish; Dev and Irep take over Fairy World.
